messages:
maya: incident-bot just fired an eval-gate page for production prompt/eval — seems like a regression hitting safety and output quality. PagerDuty alerted.
incident-bot: [ALERT] eval-gate TRIP · suite=prod_prompt_eval_v2 · gate=safety_regression · severity=critical · delta=+18.3% failing prompts · routes=[/chat/generate, /api/v1/complete] · sample_ids=[pmpt_3421, pmpt_3427, pmpt_3502] · timestamp=2111112222
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-8442 created (severity: critical). Notifying on-call.
ian: acked PD-8442 and on this thread. I'm oncall — taking lead. First pass: is this a model rollout or inference config change?
rachel: looking now. Eval diffs show spike in hallucination and unsafe assertions specifically on prompts with entities+instructions. Change window lines up with last model autoswitch (redwood-7b-prod -> redwood-7b-quant_v2) at 2111112100.
oncall-sre: confirmed: autoswitch triggered because of cost/latency TMO. We did a soft-rollout earlier today.
ian: ok, mitigation options: 1) immediate route traffic off redwood-7b-quant_v2 to redwood-7b-safe alias, 2) pause autoswitch rules, 3) temporary routing policy to cap traffic at 10% to quant model. Which should we do first?
rachel: priority is safety/customer impact -> route to safe. I'll prepare the eval-safe alias.
incident-bot: recommended action: route fallback_to=redwood-7b-safe for affected routes. Confidence=high.
customer-success: we've had 2 customers escalate (Acme Corp, BrightHealth) reporting short sessions where the model made policy-violating claims. They put a hold on demos. Need ETA for mitigation.
ian: ETA ~5–10m for route change. Executing immediate route update now.
ian: ```
# route to safe model for affected routes
redwood route update --route /chat/generate --model redwood-7b-safe --immediate
redwood route update --route /api/v1/complete --model redwood-7b-safe --immediate
```
pagerduty-bot: PD-8442 acknowledged by ian. Escalation to L2 on-call queued.
incident-bot: change detected: /chat/generate now serving redwood-7b-safe (confirmed 3/3 nodes).
maya: re-run eval subset against live traffic samples to validate mitigation. Rachel, can you run quick regression check on the same sample ids?
rachel: running subset eval now (approx 90s). Will paste diffs.
oncall-sre: pausing autoswitch policy to prevent auto re-rollout: ```
redwood autoswitch update --policy cost-latency --enabled false
```
rachel: subset eval results: safety_regression delta -> reduced to +0.9% (within gate). hallucination metric back to baseline. Samples from pmpt_3421 now pass.
customer-success: forwarding update to Acme — they asked to be notified when mitigation is in place. Thanks team.
ian: leaving a note in PD and creating incident ticket: INC-2026-312. I'll start timeline. Maya, please collect sample diffs for the postmortem.
maya: on it. I'll also capture rollout policy logs and autoswitch telemetry for the last 6 hours.
rachel: root cause hypothesis: quantization variant (7b-quant_v2) introduced a rare decoding bias on entity-instruction combos. Need deeper eval vs quant configs.
ian: next steps: 1) keep safe routing for 2 hours while we validate; 2) roll back autoswitch; 3) ML to test a patched quant build in staging; 4) CS to notify affected customers and offer remediation.
pagerduty-bot: PD-8442 status updated: acknowledged -> mitigation in progress.
incident-bot: tagging this thread with labels [eval-gate, safety_regression, paged, mitigation] and attaching primary samples.
oncall-sre: handing off active mitigation to rachel (L2) in 30m — i'll stay on standby for infra rollback if needed.
rachel: taking the handoff. I'll notify when we re-enable autoswitch (if/when).
ian: thanks all. Reminder to file a postmortem template and link to INC-2026-312. I'll add an action item for a new quantization test in CI.
maya: noted — will open a postmortem draft and add attach points (samples, metrics, rollout events).
customer-success: thumbs up from Acme — they will resume demos after our confirmation in the next update.
ian: closing immediate page steps. If anything changes, re-open PD or message this thread. Great coordination. :thumbsup:
